title: Podcast Guest Booking Kit
target_customer: Founders, freelancers, consultants and authors who want to be booked as podcast guests
problem: Cold podcast pitches get ignored because they are generic, are sent to the wrong show, and are followed up into spam territory

demand_signals.signal: Independent sellers ship paid guest-pitching / guest-booking products across three separate marketplaces (Gumroad, Etsy, and direct sites), at prices from $5.03 to $38.00.
demand_signals.evidence: 11 confirmable priced listings with observed prices (see data/evidence/b12_005_competitors.json); 4 further shape-matched Gumroad listings exist but their prices are client-rendered and were NOT guessed.
demand_signals.interpretation: Proven willingness to pay for a packaged podcast-pitching asset, at more than one price tier.

demand_signals.signal: The category's top-of-market DIY kit defines a complete product as exactly four pieces: a one-sheet, pitch templates, a pipeline tracker, and a booking page.
demand_signals.evidence: Zicula Podcast Guest Kit ($28) markets 'one-sheet generator, 8 pitch templates, a pipeline tracker with a weekly ritual, and a booking page you can publish today' as its complete contents (live page, observed 2026-10-19).
demand_signals.interpretation: The market itself says scripts-plus-tracker is the core of the product; a 2-page script sheet with a 4-sheet stub tracker does not meet the bar the category sets.

demand_signals.signal: The dominant substitute is a monthly subscription, and the category's own comparison anchors against it: $97/month, $99/month and $32/month tools.
demand_signals.evidence: Zicula's live page states 'Guestio Pro runs $97/month. Rephonic starts at $99/month. PodMatch's guest plan is $32/month. This kit costs $28 once.'
demand_signals.interpretation: A one-time price below $32/month has a clear, seller-stated anchor in this category - though that anchor is a competitor's claim, not an independent measurement.

demand_signals.signal: The category's own best-practice doctrine matches the honesty rule this factory applies: the leading kit states plainly that it is 'not a placement service' and cannot promise a booking.
demand_signals.evidence: 'It is a toolkit, not a placement service. Nothing here submits you to databases or buys you slots ... no template can promise a booking' (Zicula, live page).
demand_signals.interpretation: Our no-guarantee, no-fabricated-results framing is aligned with the category's own practice rather than a disadvantage against it.

demand_signals.signal: The market splits into two distinct jobs, and the search results for one bleed into the other: GUEST-side (pitch yourself onto shows) and HOST-side (book guests onto your own show).
demand_signals.evidence: Of the 15 listings reviewed, 5 are GUEST-side, 8 are HOST-side, 2 are both; the title 'Podcast Guest Booking Kit' is ambiguous and is read by search as the HOST-side job.
demand_signals.interpretation: A positioning risk, not a demand risk: the deliverable is guest-side while the title reads host-side. Recorded honestly because it affects copy and price comparisons.

competition_level: HIGH. 11 priced comparables in a narrow category, plus a large discounted template tier on Etsy ($2-$12) and four further Gumroad kits of the same shape. Several are one-file template packs competing on price alone.
differentiation_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH at the current build. As shipped (2-page script sheet, ~339 words, plus a stub 4-sheet tracker) this product sits below the $6-$12 template floor in substance and cannot honestly be priced near the $15-$28 kit tier. Differentiation must come from real written depth (a genuine method, worked examples, failure modes) plus a working tracker with formulas and validations - the same structure that justified B12-003/B12-004.

price.note: Price is decided only after the rebuild by running this factory's own mandatory gates (economics.market_realism_check for the page-based ceiling and the commercial-validation comparable ceiling, plus the quality gate). The manifest's $29.00 is the pre-evidence placeholder and is not treated as approved.

real_alternatives_for_a_zero_budget_buye: PodMatch / other booking platforms' free tiers
A plain Google Sheet used as a pitch tracker
Writing pitches by hand from free articles
verified_by: Claude (read-only web research, 2026-10-19); no purchase, no account, no outreach, $0
